text:
nina: quick triage - zephyria27b (int4) brought up in canary and hit intermittent OOMs during load test at 01:04. uncertain if it's prefetch math or a mismatch between CLI bench flags and model defaults.
perf-bot: task=zephyria27b-canary host=g5-16 reason=OOM_kv_reserve stack=alloc_prefetch+0x12b
omar: paste the tiny repro and current defaults?
nina: smallest log: \n[01:04:12] config defaults: prefetch_window=56 prefetch_slots=4 max_new_tokens=512 batch=20 quant=int4
[01:04:12] alloc_prefetch req=9.8GB -> kv_reserved=42.6GB
[01:04:13] OOM allocating 3.2GB for kv_prefetch\n
felix: initial guess: max_new_tokens in our model_configs was 512 but the bench CLI used --max-new=128 for other models. here the mismatch meant canary rolled with big token defaults. also prefetch_window*slots*ceil(max/128) * batch multiplies badly.
perf-bot: quick local bench requested: `bench --model zephyria27b --runs 250 --batch 16 --max-new 128 --prefetch 8 --coldstart`
perf-bot: quickbench: peak_gpu=35.6GB p95=220ms avg=78ms OOMs=0 baseline (old defaults): peak=53.2GB OOMs=3
omar: good signal. propose conservative canary patch: lower model default max_new_tokens to 128, prefetch_window to 12, prefetch_slots 2, reduce default batch to 12.
nina: also saw strange slab fragmentation metric spikes - kv_fragmentation_pct jumped near 68% before compaction. could be per-request small allocations leaking.
felix: mitigation options ranked: 1) fix defaults and canary 10% 2) add per-request prefetch cap (bytes) to avoid multi-tenant bursts 3) enable early soft_compact on startup (compactor=epochal_fast) 4) add kv_reserved_peak metric and alerting 5) schedule off-peak aggressive compaction cron if fragmentation >50%.
perf-bot: config diff suggestion:
``
models:
  zephyria27b:
    defaults:
      max_new_tokens: 128
      prefetch_window: 12
      prefetch_slots: 2
      batch: 12
      per_request_prefetch_cap_bytes: 6442450944  # 6GB
      compactor: epochal_fast
      kv_trim_on_evict: true
```
qa-bot: scheduling evals for quality check (summaries, codegen, longform). Will run on int4 canary and baseline FP16. Path: /evals/zephyria27b/2026-04-12-1815000000
perf-bot: bench artifacts uploaded s3://redwood-ci/zephyria27b/canary-1815000000
omar: quick QA note: running quant calibration for int4 shows tiny EM drop on the codegen suite ~0.9% but summarization rouge stable. need full suite.
felix: also add runtime guard: if free_kv_pool < 8GB then degrade prefetch to on-demand per-token until free_kv_pool recovers. runtime flag name: prefetch_global_cap=true
infra: tagging for kernel/driver watch - if compaction churn spikes scheduler latency we'll tune compaction scheduling.
nina: plan: 1) submit PR with config + runtime guard + new metrics 2) deploy 10% eu-west canary for 4h 3) run eval suite + perf bench 4) if quality within thresholds and no OOMs, expand to 60% and monitor kv_frag metrics 5) if fragmentation persists, flip on off-peak aggressive compaction.
omar: please also add a regression alert threshold: quality delta >1% or p95 latency +25% triggers rollback.
felix: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/4319 - CI running. attaching bench logs.
perf-bot: CI passed. canary deployment started. monitoring dashboards and eval uploads.
nina: follow-up after 3h: canary steady, kv_reserved_peak down 34%, kv_fragmentation_pct average 22%, evals show codegen EM down 0.6% summarization rouge unchanged. No OOMs. Will prepare rollout notes and RFC for safer global prefetch caps. :shipit:
